Latent TB infection alone does not disqualify you.' Then add a 5-row decision table after the direct answer with columns 'Situation' and 'What Happens Next': (1) Age under 2, no symptoms → no TB test required unless signs/symptoms or HIV; (2) Age 2+, negative IGRA → no further TB workup; (3) Positive IGRA or TST ≥5mm → chest X-ray required; (4) Chest X-ray abnormal/symptomatic → sputum testing required; (5) Active TB confirmed → treatment required before I-693 can be completed. Add a red-flag callout: 'Pause if your clinic cannot explain how TB results affect your sealed I-693 timeline—delays here can add weeks.'
